legend: You are an environmental activist at heart but the reality is harsh and you are just a cashier in a cinema. But you can still do something!

You have n$$$n$$$ tickets to sell. The price of the i$$$i$$$-th ticket is pi$$$p_i$$$. As a teller, you have a possibility to select the order in which the tickets will be sold (i.e. a permutation of the tickets). You know that the cinema participates in two ecological restoration programs applying them to the order you chose:

The x%$$$x\%$$$ of the price of each the a$$$a$$$-th sold ticket (a$$$a$$$-th, 2a$$$2a$$$-th, 3a$$$3a$$$-th and so on) in the order you chose is aimed for research and spreading of renewable energy sources.
The y%$$$y\%$$$ of the price of each the b$$$b$$$-th sold ticket (b$$$b$$$-th, 2b$$$2b$$$-th, 3b$$$3b$$$-th and so on) in the order you chose is aimed for pollution abatement.

If the ticket is in both programs then the (x+y)%$$$(x + y) \%$$$ are used for environmental activities. Also, it's known that all prices are multiples of 100$$$100$$$, so there is no need in any rounding.

For example, if you'd like to sell tickets with prices [400,100,300,200]$$$[400, 100, 300, 200]$$$ and the cinema pays 10%$$$10\%$$$ of each 2$$$2$$$-nd sold ticket and 20%$$$20\%$$$ of each 3$$$3$$$-rd sold ticket, then arranging them in order [100,200,300,400]$$$[100, 200, 300, 400]$$$ will lead to contribution equal to 100⋅0+200⋅0.1+300⋅0.2+400⋅0.1=120$$$100 \cdot 0 + 200 \cdot 0.1 + 300 \cdot 0.2 + 400 \cdot 0.1 = 120$$$. But arranging them in order [100,300,400,200]$$$[100, 300, 400, 200]$$$ will lead to 100⋅0+300⋅0.1+400⋅0.2+200⋅0.1=130$$$100 \cdot 0 + 300 \cdot 0.1 + 400 \cdot 0.2 + 200 \cdot 0.1 = 130$$$.

Nature can't wait, so you decided to change the order of tickets in such a way, so that the total contribution to programs will reach at least k$$$k$$$ in minimum number of sold tickets. Or say that it's impossible to do so. In other words, find the minimum number of tickets which are needed to be sold in order to earn at least k$$$k$$$.
input: The first line contains a single integer q$$$q$$$ (1≤q≤100$$$1 \le q \le 100$$$) — the number of independent queries. Each query consists of 5$$$5$$$ lines.
The first line of each query contains a single integer n$$$n$$$ (1≤n≤2⋅105$$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$) — the number of tickets.
The second line contains n$$$n$$$ integers p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \dots, p_n$$$ (100≤pi≤109$$$100 \le p_i \le 10^9$$$, pimod100=0$$$p_i \bmod 100 = 0$$$) — the corresponding prices of tickets.
The third line contains two integers x$$$x$$$ and a$$$a$$$ (1≤x≤100$$$1 \le x \le 100$$$, x+y≤100$$$x + y \le 100$$$, 1≤a≤n$$$1 \le a \le n$$$) — the parameters of the first program.
The fourth line contains two integers y$$$y$$$ and b$$$b$$$ (1≤y≤100$$$1 \le y \le 100$$$, x+y≤100$$$x + y \le 100$$$, 1≤b≤n$$$1 \le b \le n$$$) — the parameters of the second program.
The fifth line contains single integer k$$$k$$$ (1≤k≤1014$$$1 \le k \le 10^{14}$$$) — the required total contribution.
It's guaranteed that the total number of tickets per test doesn't exceed 2⋅105$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$.
output: Print q$$$q$$$ integers — one per query.
For each query, print the minimum number of tickets you need to sell to make the total ecological contribution of at least k$$$k$$$ if you can sell tickets in any order.
If the total contribution can not be achieved selling all the tickets, print −1$$$-1$$$.
note: In the first query the total contribution is equal to 50+49=99<100$$$50 + 49 = 99  \lt  100$$$, so it's impossible to gather enough money.
In the third query the full price of each ticket goes to the environmental activities.

In the fourth query you can rearrange tickets as [100,200,100,100,100]$$$[100, 200, 100, 100, 100]$$$ and the total contribution from the first 4$$$4$$$ tickets is 100⋅0+200⋅0.31+100⋅0+100⋅0.31=62+31=93$$$100 \cdot 0 + 200 \cdot 0.31 + 100 \cdot 0 + 100 \cdot 0.31 = 62 + 31 = 93$$$.

legend.ai: 你内心是环保主义者，但现实很残酷，你只是一名电影院的售票员。不过你仍然可以做些什么！
你有 n$$$n$$$ 张票需要出售。第 i$$$i$$$ 张票的价格为 pi$$$p_i$$$。作为售票员，你可以选择售出票的顺序(即这些票的一个排列)。你知道电影院参与了两个生态修复项目，它们会按照你选择的顺序执行：
在你选择的顺序中，每第 a$$$a$$$ 张售出的票(第 a$$$a$$$、2a$$$2a$$$、3a$$$3a$$$ 张，以此类推)的票价的 x%$$$x\%$$$ 将用于可再生能源的研究与推广。
在你选择的顺序中，每第 b$$$b$$$ 张售出的票(第 b$$$b$$$、2b$$$2b$$$、3b$$$3b$$$ 张，以此类推)的票价的 y%$$$y\%$$$ 将用于污染治理。
如果一张票同时属于两个项目，那么 (x+y)%$$$(x + y) \%$$$ 会用于环保活动。另外，已知所有价格都是 100$$$100$$$ 的倍数，因此无需进行任何舍入。
大自然等不及了，因此你决定改变票的顺序，使项目获得的总贡献额在售出票数最少的情况下至少达到 k$$$k$$$。或者说明无法做到。换句话说，求至少需要售出多少张票才能筹集到 k$$$k$$$。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 q$$$q$$$(1≤q≤100$$$1 \le q \le 100$$$)——独立询问的数量。每个询问由 5$$$5$$$ 行组成。
每个询问的第一行包含一个整数 n$$$n$$$(1≤n≤2⋅105$$$1 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$$$)——票的数量。
第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 p1,p2,…,pn$$$p_1, p_2, \dots, p_n$$$(100≤pi≤109$$$100 \le p_i \le 10^9$$$, pimod100=0$$$p_i \bmod 100 = 0$$$)——分别表示对应票的价格。
第五行包含一个整数 k$$$k$$$(1≤k≤1014$$$1 \le k \le 10^{14}$$$)——所需的总贡献值。
保证每个测试用例中的票券总数不超过 2⋅105$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$。

output.ai: 输出 q$$$q$$$ 个整数——每个查询输出一个。
对于每个查询，如果可以按任意顺序售出票券，输出使总生态贡献至少为 k$$$k$$$ 所需售出的最少票数。
如果通过出售所有门票也无法筹集到总额，则输出 −1$$$-1$$$。

note.ai: 在第一次询问中，总贡献等于 50+49=99<100$$$50 + 49 = 99  \lt  100$$$，因此不可能筹集到足够的钱。
在第三次询问中，每张门票的全部票价都用于环保活动。
